entries.reason: A runtime FileDescriptorSet is the single field contract for a registered schema id and version.
entries.schema: The caller supplies a stable schema id, positive version, FileDescriptorSet and full message name; registration rejects duplicate legacy or Protobuf ownership of the same pair.
entries.version: Exact registered version only; no implicit nearest-version fallback.
entries.migration: Migration is explicit at the owning domain boundary; unknown schema versions are rejected.
entries.unknown_fields: Strict protobuf JSON parsing rejects unknown fields; binary-to-JSON projection rejects unknown wire fields recursively.
entries.restore_atomicity: Descriptor registration builds a private pool and publishes it only after every file and message resolves. Encoding and decoding do not mutate domain state.

entries.reason: Runtime descriptor sets provide a typed binary and JSON projection boundary for dynamically generated proto messages.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: Register, clear, encode and decode run on the schema registry thread; registration does not overlap serialization.
cost_notes: Descriptor pools are built once per schema version; encoding and decoding cost O(message size) at serialization boundaries.
